title: Hie
summary: HIE, verb intransitive 1. To hasten; to move or run with haste; to go in haste; a word chiefly used in poetry. The youth, returning to his mistress, hies. 2. With the reciprocal pronoun; as, hie thee

inlines.v: HIE, verb intransitive 1. To hasten; to move or run with haste; to go in haste; a word chiefly used in poetry. The youth, returning to his mistress, hies. 2. With the reciprocal pronoun; as, hie thee home. HIE, noun Haste; diligence.
